task_description: Build a full-stack fitness challenge verification platform called VitaVerse. Features: email/password auth, phone OTP verification, Strava OAuth integration for activity data, fitness challenges with auto-verification against Strava data, QR code generation for completed challenges, and a QR scanner/verification page that shows green (valid) or red (invalid).

verification.summary: npm run build succeeds. All 22 routes/pages compiled (12 API routes, 8 static pages, 1 dynamic page, 1 not-found). TypeScript passes. Security review conducted and 5 issues fixed (OTP phone mismatch, brute-force protection, Strava CSRF state, challenges auth, duplicated code). 29 source files total.
